summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 title format entry and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title() beside show_cursor() (buffers only when is_terminal, returns True/False); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title) once; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests added in test_console.py (skipped on win32), test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only). Verification was by reading only: tests and Black were not run, and no added line exceeds 88 characters. Nothing committed.
